description:
As a customer, I want to filter the products.

* Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

criteria.text: Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

cases.title: Applying a single filter narrows the product list correctly
cases.preconditions: The product list page is reachable and contains <a set of products where some match a given filter value and some do not>. At least one filter is available on the product list.
steps: Open the product list page without any filter applied.
Note the products currently shown in the list.
Apply a single filter with <a filter value matched by some of the listed products>.
Compare the resulting list with the products noted in step 2.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed to only the products that match the applied filter value; products that do not match the filter value are no longer shown.

cases.title: Applying two filters at the same time narrows the list to products matching both
cases.preconditions: The product list page is reachable and contains <products that match filter value A only, products that match filter value B only, and at least one product that matches both A and B>. At least two filters are available on the product list.
steps: Open the product list page without any filter applied.
Apply the first filter with <filter value A>.
Apply the second filter with <filter value B> while the first filter is still applied.
Compare the resulting list with the products noted in step 3.
cases.expected: The list shows only the products that match both filter values; products matching only one of the two values are no longer shown.

cases.title: Applying a filter that no product matches
cases.preconditions: The product list page is reachable and contains products, none of which match <a filter value that no product in the list matches>.
steps: Open the product list page without any filter applied.
Apply a filter with <a filter value that no product in the list matches>.
cases.expected: No products are shown in the list, as none match the applied filter. The exact empty-list message or presentation is not specified in the story.
